summary.text: Jay Leftwich is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 90, which covers part of the City of Chesapeake.
Jay Leftwich has been a member since 2014.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Jay Leftwich was born in Portsmouth, Virginia, in 1962.
Jay Leftwich studied at James Madison University (B.S., 1985) and the University of Richmond's T.C. Williams School of Law (J.D., 1988).
Jay Leftwich's listed occupation is attorney.

Jay Leftwich's listed memberships and affiliations include River Oak Church (former elder), Ruritan (former president), the Jaycees (former president), the Chesapeake Bar Association (former president), Chesapeake Care Inc. (former director), and the American Cancer Society (former director).
The profile lists Renee D. as Jay Leftwich's spouse.
The House profile lists Jay Leftwich's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections and Courts of Justice.
